shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- auth ---\\n' && cat app/lib/auth.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "cat app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && cat app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- git ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p app/admin cat > app/admin/page.tsx <<'EOF' import Link from 'next/link' import { forbidden } from 'next/navigation' import { connection } from 'next/server' import { getSession } from '@/app/lib/auth' export default async function AdminPage() { await connection() const session = await getSession() if (session?.role "'!== '"'admin') { forbidden() } return (

Administration

Admin Dashboard

Welcome, {session.name}.

Return to home
) } EOF cat > app/admin/forbidden.tsx <<'EOF' import Link from 'next/link' export default function Forbidden() { return (

403 · FORBIDDEN

Access denied

You need an administrator account to view this page. If you believe you should have access, contact your administrator.

Return to home
) } EOF cat > next.config.ts <<'EOF' import type { NextConfig } from 'next' const nextConfig: NextConfig = { experimental: { authInterrupts: true, }, } export default nextConfig EOF"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /tmp/admin-response.html -w 'status=%{http_code}\\ncontent-type=%{content_type}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3100/admin && rg -o '403 · FORBIDDEN|Access denied|administrator account|Admin Dashboard|noindex' /tmp/admin-response.html | sort | uniq -c"

/bin/bash -lc "git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json
python3 -c \"import pathlib, shutil; shutil.rmtree('.next'); pathlib.Path('next-env.d.ts').unlink()\"
git status --short"
